title: Women's Doubles Pair Change for World Junior Championships Trials
indian_angle: This update directly impacts Indian junior women's doubles players vying for a spot in the World Junior Championships.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has announced a change in the women's doubles pair composition for the upcoming selection trials of the VICTOR BWF World Junior Championships 2026.

title: Junior National Coaching Camp in Guwahati for Asia U17 & U15 Championships
indian_angle: This camp at the National Center of Excellence in Guwahati is crucial for preparing India's top junior talent for the Badminton Asia U17 & U15 Junior Championships.
summary: An Indian team coaching camp for the Badminton Asia U17 & U15 Junior Championships 2026 is currently underway at the National Center of Excellence in Guwahati.

title: Final Selection Trials List Released for BWF World Junior Championships
indian_angle: Indian junior players have received the list of qualified athletes and eligibility criteria for the final selection trials to represent the nation at the BWF World Junior Championships in Cairo.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has released the player eligibility criteria and the list of qualified players for the final selection trials for the VICTOR BWF World Junior Championships 2026 in Cairo, Egypt.

title: Haryana U-19 Tournament Postponed, Bhubaneswar Becomes World Junior Selection Event
indian_angle: This change affects Indian junior players aiming for the BWF World Junior Championships, as the Bhubaneswar tournament is now a crucial selection event.
summary: The Haryana U-19 Ranking Tournament has been postponed, and the Bhubaneswar U-19 Ranking Tournament has been declared as the official selection tournament for the BWF World Junior Championships 2026.

title: New 3x15 Scoring System Adopted for Junior Domestic Tournaments
indian_angle: This new scoring system will be implemented across all domestic ranking tournaments and national championships for U-13, U-15, and U-17 age groups in India.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has announced the implementation of the 3x15 scoring system for all domestic ranking tournaments and national championships in the U-13, U-15, and U-17 age categories.
